entities.name: 106.9 Sangre y arena
entities.source_summary: Local Spanish-language radio station broadcasting Rancho Coronado survival information, hazards and neighborhood notices; references to local sales are news items rather than station retail.

services.label: Local radio news and survival information

entities.name: Coronado Heights
entities.source_summary: Relatively high-quality studio-apartment building inhabited by Playland workers and gang members; the entry describes residents and utilities but no customer-facing sales or rental operation.

entities.name: The Culms
entities.source_summary: Weng Fang Tong-controlled mutant-bamboo harvesting operation whose output is sold to companies across Night City for construction scaffolding; labor is coercive and the site is not public retail.

entities.name: Jack 'N' the Green
entities.source_summary: Large guerrilla garden and major supplier of fresh produce to high-end restaurants citywide; the local radio also reports occasional cheap sales of blemished produce to residents.
entities.catalogue_note: Produce is site-specific agricultural output rather than a generic food-store assortment.
